status: DESIGN, RUN 2026-09-27, for the owner's review. NOT APPLIED: the canonical heightmap is untouched. tools/water_shape.py applies this file to a COPY under derived/water_shape/ and draws the maps; tools/water_shape_audit.py checks the copy (167 checks, CLEAN on the 2026-09-27 run). Every target the run could not meet on real terrain was changed here with a RUN or MEASURED why beside it; docs/world-building/WATER_SHAPE.md has the measured numbers.
plan: docs/mechanics/WATER_BUILD_PLAN.md (Phase B: items 1, 3 and 4's shape, one revision, one staging export)

applies_to.why: the revision is one final stage on the canonical heightmap, in tools/rift_heightmap.py's pattern: it starts from the file data/world.json pins, writes a new file, and every column outside the declared features stays bit-identical. The tool refuses any other input

output.why: a copy for review. Applying it (writing the file beside the canonical one and repinning data/world.json as heightmap.water_shaped_from) is a separate, owner-approved step: python tools/water_shape.py --source-root <root> --apply, which this revision does not run

decisions.1: Trained players do NOT tire underwater; air alone limits dives. Fatigue is the surface gate, air the underwater gate
decisions.3: The ferry IS the gate for players without a water mount
decisions.4: The Viltri Ravine: option B, an underfit stream from a spring at the pass down the sea half only; the lake half stays dry
decisions.5: One water export for all heightmap work
decisions.6: The seabed pass at full scope (OCEAN.md section 4)
decisions.7: Fungal Isle at S0 by a sand-bar chain, never more than about 40 blocks of 3-deep water at a time; Relic stays as it is (swimmable from the beach, the row from the jetty)
decisions.8: Lake shelves and shoals as rest points: every lake gets a wadeable shelf, every dive site a rest point within its rung's budget
decisions.9: Meanders on the low-grade reaches, cascades on the steep creeks, the Tilpey gorge unchanged under its bridge
decisions.10: The trio's hooks are visible from any stage (their sites are kept as keep zones here; the hooks are blocks, Phase C)
decisions.owner_item_1: Rivers that feel like they flow. Lakes that read as lakes, not step-down bowls: shelves, drop-offs, weed beds, silt, structure.
decisions.owner_item_3: SHALLOWS AND SHORE WATER. The only sea a player meets before Dive at gym 6. Give it real attention: it is a third of the game and currently nothing.

principles.rule: Shape only. Everything here is a height. Materials, plants, coral, drift, grottos, caves, the trench and docks are blocks (Phase C) and are not in this file
Bit-identical outside the features' declared footprints; the audit compares the copy with the canonical file column by column
Nothing already placed moves: no column inside a town footprint, on a road, in the Rift, under Victory Road, under a bridge, under the islet or the sea town, or under a built water event site changes
principles.why: the owner's list for this task, and tools/rift_heightmap.py's protect rule

principles.rule: Swim-rate invariance outside the declared coast features: no column that is 3 or more deep before becomes shallower than 3, anywhere except inside a coast feature that declares it; the seabed pass never raises a column above y59
principles.why: the swim rule charges 4 a tick in water 3 or more deep and 1 in shallower (data/blackout.json surface); keeping every column's rate class fixed keeps every ferry gate a gate by construction (decision 3), and the few features that do add rest ground (the Fungal chain, the flats, the skerries, the lake shelves) are walked by the audit

principles.rule: Lakes keep their level and their shoreline: no lake column at or above level - 1 changes, and no lake column is raised to level or above
principles.why: WATER_BUILD_PLAN 3.3; towns, routes, foliage and the basin polygons stay valid

principles.rule: Every river still drains end to end: water surfaces never rise downstream and step only at declared riffles, cascades and falls

to_sea.rule: from the axis's low end, follow the steepest non-rising ground until a column below sea level connected to the open sea; the stream ends there at level 62. Fails if the sea is not reached

lakes.why: Owner item 1 ('lakes that read as lakes, not step-down bowls'), decision 8. Finding F2: every bed is a ramp of one-block terraces, 78-92% of neighbouring bed columns level, no shelf, no drop-off, no structure; wadeable 4-16%; the deepest point 47-179 blocks from anywhere to stand
lakes.profile: littoral shelf (1 deep on its inner part, 2 on its outer), a drop-off to drop_depth over drop_width blocks, then a basin floor mapped from the old ramp with floor_gamma (the floor plunges near the drop-off and flattens toward the deepest point, which keeps its depth); low noise on the floor; humps; shoals to 1 deep as rest points; keep zones untouched

unaided.why: a swimmer goes out and back: 2 x 30 = 60 deep blocks, warned and slowed, no hit (first hit at 75)

trained.why: Surf or Dive training halves the rate: 2 x 60 = 120 of 150. Decision 1 keeps a trained diver from tiring underwater; this is the surface budget

bodies.shoals_why: RUN 2026-09-27: Tilpey is about 1,300 by 900 blocks. Keeping every point within the trained rung's 60 of rest took 48 small round crests at random angles and still measured 87 (the map read as scattered seeds), and 81 long bars to reach 60. Its sunken islands are now long bars on one trend (bearing 135, the line of the lake's north-west arm, +-14 degrees), a drowned drumlin field that reads as the valley's grain, and its budget is the rung's figure without margin: 75 out and 75 back is the 150 deep blocks before a trained swimmer's first hit (the 60 keeps 30 in hand). Measured: 81 bars for 60, about 45 for 75. Owner question 4 in WATER_SHAPE.md asks whether the whole lake, or only its dive sites, should be within the budget

seabed.reading: FINDING: OCEAN.md section 4 says both 'where the planned shelf is shallower than the imported surface, the pass fills up to it' and 'where the imported surface is deeper than the profile, the pass keeps the imported surface'; read literally the two cover the same columns and contradict. Its per-zone medians (Southern Shallows y24 to y51) show filling was meant. This design fills to the profile and carries every erosion canyon through the fill as an incision of the same depth, so the canyons survive as canyons

margin.status: NOT IN THE HEIGHTMAP: needs an owner decision
margin.why: all five seamounts ((-600, 2200), (-500, 6000), (4200, -700), (9000, 1800), (1500, 8900)) lie outside the 0-8191 heightmap. tools/worldpainter/export_world.js imports the margin from a blank image (the y10 plain), so no heightmap revision can shape them. The generator previews them on the seabed overview only
options: A: a margin relief image beside the heightmap, pinned by sha256 in data/world.json and read by export_world.js in place of the blank image (recommended)
B: build them as a block pass after the export (about 3 million blocks each)
C: leave the margin a plain until postgame
